rules.title: Scope Boundaries Must Be Explicit
rules.summary: Implementation work must identify the intended scope boundary before coding starts, including the target subsystem, affected files or areas, and any out-of-scope concerns that should be flagged rather than silently absorbed.
signals: no declared subsystem or work area
changes spread into unrelated files without justification
implicit scope changes appear only in implementation notes or diffs

rules.title: Required Planning Artefacts Must Exist
rules.summary: Before non-trivial implementation work begins, the expected planning artefacts must exist for the class of change being attempted.
signals: missing requirement or strategy document for a new feature
missing architecture document for backend-meaningful work
missing design document for front-end workflow changes
missing acceptance criteria

rules.title: Review Evidence Must Be Traceable
rules.summary: Work that claims review completion must leave traceable evidence of findings, tests, or explicit deferrals rather than relying on unstructured narrative.
signals: no evidence directory or review file for substantial work
findings discussed in prose without IDs or status
unresolved issues not marked as deferred, accepted, or resolved

rules.title: Four-Tier Orchestrator Dispatch Is the Standard Build Method
rules.summary: Implementation-heavy and review-heavy work is distributed across tiers, written test-first, and put through parallel adversarial review: Opus orchestrates and adjudicates; Codex executes in an isolated worktree per dispatch; three Sonnet reviewers run an adversarial review in parallel; the operator verifies against a live datastore. Deviation is note-and-justify.
signals: a substantive code change merged with no parallel 3-agent adversarial-review evidence
review agents run sequentially rather than three in parallel on a governance-heavy change
a behaviour change merged with no operator-authored RED test / TDD trail
a Codex dispatch with scope_boundary of * / **, or --sandbox danger-full-access
bulk implementation hand-written by the Opus session where a Codex Tier-3 dispatch would do, with no note-and-justify deviation record

rules.title: Estate Operating Stance Is Dev/Staging Only
rules.summary: This is a single-operator dev/staging estate with no production tier and no live customers. Prod-grade gates, secret-rotation alarms, multi-week soak windows, and cost-gating must not be applied; verify correctness directly and decide on it-works-or-it-does-not, still using the PR workflow and never silently descoping. Revisit at the first production launch.
signals: a change or review that treats an estate instance as production, or applies a prod-only gate, with no live-customer basis
a dev or demo secret or in-chat PAT flagged for rotation as a current blocker
a multi-week observation or soak window or calendar gate imposed on a dev decision
cost used as a reason to block, slow, descope, or deprioritise feature work before go-live

rules.title: The Serving Path Reads Only Sanctioned Sources (No Shortcuts)
rules.summary: A governed app's serving path may read only sources on the sanctioned-sources allowlist. A serving-path read of an unsanctioned source, a new/unclassified serving directory, or a dynamically-constructed serving filename are the ways a demo 'goes green' by quietly reading a hand-curated fixture instead of the canonical index. The allowlist ratchet is shrink-only. Enforced by SCP-R-014 (warn-baseline; DORMANT until the conformance-tcb materialiser companion lands; LIVE enforcement today is the conformance-tcb repo gate).
signals: a serving-path read of a source not on the sanctioned-sources allowlist
a new or unclassified serving directory that reads before it is classified
a dynamically-constructed serving filename that defeats static allowlist verification
the sanctioned-sources allowlist grows rather than shrinks (ratchet violation)

rules.title: Integrity-Green Is Required to Leave RED
rules.summary: A conformance board cell may not be marked non-RED unless every integrity clause holds: the computed-from-proof status agrees with the claimed status (no typed override), the standing fake-mutant failed its test (the test discriminates), a CI-observed ledger-signed RED preceded the flip (red-first), and the transition classifier confirms an SUT-only cumulative diff with TCB byte-identity. This is the anti-'fake-done' gate: a cell must go green by making the real join pass, not by editing the board or the test harness. The correctness tier (external/attested) is a separate required tag. Enforced by SCP-R-015 (warn-baseline; DORMANT until the conformance-tcb materialiser companion lands; LIVE enforcement today is the conformance-tcb repo gate).
signals: a cell marked non-RED whose typed status disagrees with the computed-from-proof status
a cell marked non-RED whose standing fake-mutant did not fail its test
a cell marked non-RED with no CI-observed ledger-signed RED preceding it
a cell marked non-RED whose transition classifier reports a non-SUT-only diff or TCB drift

rules.title: TCB Integrity and No Self-Certification
rules.summary: Protect the Trusted Computing Base of the conformance harness and forbid self-certification: a diff touching a trust-root-covered path requires a fresh hardware-token operator counter-signature; a green must be minted under the sanctioned pinned-container OIDC subject and recorded in the append-only ledger (no SUT-triggered job may assume the mint subject); a CI-gate / branch-protection edit requires an operator signature; and a typed board status may not disagree with the computed proof. The operator counter-signature is supplied out-of-band by the operator's hardware token, never fabricated by the agent fleet. Enforced by SCP-R-016 (warn-baseline; DORMANT until the conformance-tcb materialiser companion lands; LIVE enforcement today is the conformance-tcb repo gate).
signals: a trust-root-covered path modified without a fresh hardware-token operator counter-signature
a green minted outside the sanctioned pinned-container OIDC subject, or with no matching append-only ledger entry
a CI-gate or branch-protection path edited without an operator signature
a typed board status that disagrees with the computed proof (fake-done)
